lines.en: Legends have it that centuries ago...a single family ruled over all of Kumon-mi.
Many armies, with the aid of mercenaries and sellswords tried to overthrow this family...
But every attempt amounted to nothing more than senseless bloodshed and a shameful voyage back home...
But one day, after hundreds of years and nearly one thousand fruitless attempts...
The family that had once ruled over Kumon-mi...
Fell.
And from that moment on...
They were never able to recover.
Until today.
When one girl begins her conquest...
To reclaim what is rightfully hers...
Disclaimer: Lessons in Love contains large amounts of information and data that is factually incorrect and no words should be taken as gospel.
: My name is Ayane Amamiya of the Amamiya family...and I am here to take back what is mine!
: Oh please...You really expect me to believe that a child like you aims to take back Kumon-mi?
: Woah, where did that huge lens flare come from?!
: This territory belongs to the Arakawas now, little girl...
: The Amamiyas have had no place here since the...War of...Blood.
: Who are you calling a little girl, you pathetic weakling?
: The War of Blood may have ended a long time ago, but the stains it left on these grounds have yet to be forgotten.
: Do you have any idea how many lives have been taken with just these hands alone? Because it's more than you could possibly fathom.
: Heed my words, Arakawa. If you have even the slightest desire to survive, you'll-
: I’ll what? Walk away from here and give up on Kumon-mi?
: Ahh! There are even more of them now!
: You’re out of your mind.
: I have spent the last nine thousand years honing my power and-
: What?! Nine thousand?!
: There is no way that can be right! Can it?!
: Nine thousand years is nothing to me.
: After all, I was born with...
: That bloodline...
: What?! That bloodline?!
: Yes...
: THAT BLOODLINE!!!
: This can't be...all this time I thought I was the protagonist, but...
: If he has that bloodline...
: Could this be the end of my journey?...
: It can’t be...
: Not after all I've sacrificed...
: I’ve come too far to give up now...there has to be something I can do...
: It’s over, Ayane...I have the high ground.
: We’re on the same level! You're just a little taller!
: But, you see...that’s where you’re wrong...
: You and I will never be on the same level...
: It doesn’t matter how much you train or how many of my underlings you defeat...
: This is the end of the road. Defeating me isn’t possible...
: Then you leave me no choice...
: No...It can’t be!
: It can!
: You’ve given me no choice but to unleash the Amamiya family’s hidden technique!
: Amamiya, for the last time, put that thing away! You’re going to get us shut down!
: Miss Osaka! Turn the fan speed up! My hair isn't blowing fast enough!
: We don't have a-
: Wait, where did this giant fan even come from?!
: I’m sorry things have to end this way...
: You deserve the death of a warrior, not that of a dog.
: Hah...
: Hahahah...
: ...What's so funny?
: Hahahahaha!
: Wait...No...
: He can't be...
: But I can...
: You’ve fallen into my trap, little girl.
: You see...
: I was born immune to bullets.
: No! That can’t be!
: It is!
The staredown between the two fierce warriors goes on for hours...
Days...
Weeks...
Millennia...
But the sheer respect for one another’s power is enough to force them into exercising more caution than they ever have before.
This was the moment they had lived for...
The moment to finally prove who the rightful ruler of Kumon-mi is!
How will it end?!
Who will triumph?
Will Ayane Amamiya take back the land her family had all but built with their bare hands?!
Or...
Will the mysterious ronin, clad only in sweatpants and a T-shirt, be able to fend off the legendary Amamiya fighting style?!
Find out next time on Lessons in Love ~ The Battle for Kumon-mi!

Pluuuuus...EXTRA!
: So yeah, that’s basically how you do karate.
: Are you two seriously just going to leave this thing here?! What am I supposed to do about this?!
: I feel like I actually did pretty well.
: Yeah, you were surprisingly good. You really had me going with that whole bloodline thing.
: Thanks. Came up with that off the top of my head. Totally not a play on a mildly obscure video series from 2009.
: Wow, that seems so long ago.
: Yeah. We’re dying faster than we like to admit.
: Well, you are at least. I’m a perfectly healthy, able-bodied [young_girl] who is going to take back her family’s land through martial arts!
: Just remember, you’ll have to defeat me first.
: Seriously. What the fuck am I supposed to do about this?
: Pfft. You make it sound like defeating you is supposed to be a challenge.
: It will be now that you know I’m immune to bullets.
: Also, where the hell did you get that gun? It looked real.
: There are three things you never ask a lady, Sensei! Her age, her weight, and where she got her automatic rifle.
: I don’t remember ever learning about that last one.
: Then maybe it’s time to start studying up!
: When you aren’t too busy training to defeat me, I mean.
: Right, right.
: Anyway, we should probably get a move on before the instructor asks us to do something about the industrial size fan you had air lifted here for our sparring match today.
: Yeah. It's a good thing she hasn't noticed it yet.
: I want this thing gone in ten minutes or the two of you aren't allowed back anymore.
: I'll call in another helicopter...
Ayane and I finish up our ‘karate’ routine for the day and change back into our normal clothes while waiting for the helicopter to arrive.
Unfortunately, she has to feed her chicken after this, so the two of us need to break apart and go our separate ways.
Without anything left to do, I depart the dojo and begin to wander the streets in search of something to close out the day with...
Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!
